SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.post_id, sp.post_code, sp.post_name, sp.status AS post_status, (vpe.id IS NOT NULL) AS post_effective, up.is_primary, up.created_at, up.updated_at, up.created_by, up.updated_by, up.version, up.remark FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON sp.id = up.post_id LEFT JOIN v_post_effective vpe ON vpe.id = sp.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}
AND sp.post_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.postName}, '%' )
AND sp.post_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.postCode}, '%' )
ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, up.created_at DESC, up.id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, post_id, is_primary, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version, remark FROM user_post WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
